app_fee.value: The non-refundable application processing fee is A$150, with waivers only in the limited cases listed on the fees page.
app_fee.quote: You need to pay a non-refundable application processing fee of A$150.00.

fee_waiver.value: The fee is waived only for sponsored applicants, current students and some recruitment-event attendees, and generally not for programs with a quota.
fee_waiver.quote: Generally, fee waivers are not available for programs that have a quota.

also.quote: Recipient of a full scholarship or sponsorship

gre_general.value: The application and faculty pages checked do not mention a GRE General requirement, so check each department.

toefl_min.value: The University accepts TOEFL iBT (TOEFL Australia version only, 0-120 scale), but the minimum is set in a concordance table not read here.

ielts_min.value: The standard research-degree minimum is an overall IELTS of 6.5 with no band below 6.0; some faculties and courses set higher.
ielts_min.quote: The University's standard English language proficiency requirement is set at an overall IELTS score of 6.5 with no band below 6.0, however, some faculties and courses have different requirements.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the English-speaking country list, so an Indian degree counts only if the University assesses it case by case; it must be completed within five years of the course start.
english_waiver.quote: If you completed studies in a different country, you can prove your proficiency through satisfactory achievement in: | one-year of full-time study in a postgraduate degree conducted entirely in English, including all teaching, assessments and examinations, assessed on a case-by-case basis by the University. | Your studies must be undertaken in English within five years of the date you will commence your course.

notes: Graduate-school rules from the international how-to-apply, English requirements and fee pages. Faculties can set their own IELTS and course-page rules; the engineering course page could not be read.
